title: Driver Pay Schedule 4: Fee on Instant Cashouts to an External Debit Card
content:
Each instant cashout under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** books one fee row, and a cashout to an external debit card costs the cashout fee below. The cashout fee follows the instant cashouts to an external debit card already made today, the calendar day in the driver's market time, and the account's payout method:

- while fewer external debit card cashouts have been made today than the free external cashouts per day under the driver's Pro status, the cashout is free;
- once those free cashouts are used, an account whose scheduled payouts go to the Wayfare debit card pays 0.40;
- once those free cashouts are used, any other account pays the external debit card cashout fee under the driver's Pro status.

## 4.1 Figures by Wayfare Pro status (USD)

| Status for the quarter | Free external debit card cashouts per day | Fee once the free cashouts are used: scheduled payouts to the Wayfare debit card | Fee once the free cashouts are used: any other payout method |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 0 | 0.40 | 1.25 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 0 | 0.40 | 0.85 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 1 | 0.40 | 0.85 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 1 | 0.40 | 0.50 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 2 | 0.40 | 0.50 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 5 | 0.40 | 0.00 |

## 4.2 Reading the free count

The free count compares the number of external debit card cashouts already made today with the status's free cashouts per day. Cashouts to the Wayfare debit card do not enter that count.

| Hypothetical driver | External debit card cashouts already made today | Payout method | Fee on the next external debit card cashout |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 1 | Bank deposit | 0.00 (1 is fewer than 2) |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 2 | Bank deposit | 0.50 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 2 | Wayfare debit card | 0.40 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 0 | Bank deposit | 0.00 (0 is fewer than 1) |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 0 | Wayfare debit card | 0.40 (no free cashouts at Silver) |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 0 | Bank deposit | 1.25 |
